answer: Treat the registry as a garden with 200 plots per epoch, auctioned. Claiming a plot locks a bid of at least 25 units, refunded after audited work; a fake that does nothing forfeits it. Ten plots lock at least 250 units, and the own bids of the attacker push the clearing price up, so each later fake costs more than the last. The atlas cannot be filled by an echo of copies.
